0. FOREWORD

0.1 This Indian Standard was adopted by the Indian Standards Institution on 27 Septemher 1963, after the draft finalized by the Dairy Industry Sectional Committcc had brcn approved by the Agricultural and Food Products Division Council.

0.2 The cheese knife specified
sized dairies manufacturing

in this standard cheese.

is meant

for use in small-

0.3 Wherever a reference to any Indian Standard appears in this specification, it shall be taken as a reference to-the latest version of the standard. 0.4 Metric system has been adopted in India and all quantities dimensions in this standard have been given in this system. and

0.5 For the purpose of deciding whether a particular requirement of this standard is complied with, the final value, observed or calculated, expressing the result of a test or analysis, shall be rounded off in accordance with IS : 2-1960 Rules for Rounding Off Numerical Values ( Revised). The number significant places retained in the rounded off value should be the same as that of the specified value in this standard.

of

0.6 This standard is intended chiefly to cover the technical relating to cheese knife, and it does not include all the necessary of a contract.

provisions provisions

,.l. SCOPE 1.1 This standard prescribes the requirements fbr cheese knife, horizontal and vertical, used for cutting cheese curd into cubes of uniform size.
2. GENERAL or two handles.

DESCRIPTION
wires and one

2.1 Cheese knife shall consist of a frame fitted with cutting 3. SHAPE AND DIMENSIONS 3.1 The cheese knife, horizontal and vertical, shall the shape and dimensions given in Fig. 1 or Fig. 2.
3

generally

conform

to

IS:2498-1963 3.1.1 The dimensions given in Fig. 1 and Fig. 2 are only approximate and variations shall bc pcrmittcd so long as the knife conforms to the general description and functions efficiently. 4. MATERIALS
frame and handle rod shall be made of stainless steel or mild sterl as rcquilcd by the purchaser. The cutting wires shall be made of stainless steel of designation 07Cr19Ni9 of Table XXXIV in IS : 1570-1961 Schedules for Wrought Steels for General Engineering .l?urpoaes where stainless steel frame is used and of sprin g steel wire of composition in accordance with the designation C45 of Table II in IS : 1570-1961 where mild steel frame is used. The handle shall be of well-seasoned teak or any other hardwood wllich shall not impart to cheese any odour, colour or tastr. The timber shall be free from sapwood, knots, cracks, decay and other objectionable defects.

4.1 The

5. FABRICUTION
!L.1 The frame shall be made by welding. The cutting wires shall be fitted in position as shown in Fig. .l or Fig. 2. The wires shall be fitted in grooves in the case of stainless steel knives. The grooves shall be filled with silver solder ( see *IS : 192-1956 Specification for Silver Solder ). 5.2 The handle rod shall be welded to the frame. The wooden handle shall be fittrd on the handle rod and secured in position by using a stainless steel or mild steel tinned washer and flattening at the end of the handle rod. The frame may be provided with one or two handles. If one handle is used, it shall be located at the centre of the frame.

6. FINIS#&
and shall be polished bright before fixing the cutting wires. The mild steel frame with the handle rod welded to it shall be heavily tinned by hot dip process. The tin used for tinning shall conform to Grade Sn 99.75 of tIS : 26-1956 Specification for Tin Ingot ( Revised ). The cutting wires, if made of spring steel wire, shall be electro-tin-plated in accordance with Class A of tIS : 1359-1959 Specification for .Electro-Tin Plating. 6.2 The wooden handle shall be smoothly finished and well-polished.

6.1 The stainless steel frame shall be free from sharp corners

7. MARKING 7.1 The cheese knife shall be marked legibly and permanently
following particulars: a) Manufacturer's 7.1.1 Mark. name or trade-mark with the

or initials, if any; and

b) Year of manufacture. Each cheese knife may also be marked with the IS1 Certification

NOTE-The use of the IS1 Certification Mark is governed by the provisions of the Indian Standards Institution (Certification Marks ) Act and the Rules and Regulations made thereunder. The IS1 Mark on products covered by an Indian Standard conveys the assurance that they have been produced to comply with the requirements of that standard under a well-defined &stem of inspection, testing and quality control which is devised and supervised by IS1 and operated by the producer. IS1 marked products are also continuously checked by ISI for conformity to that Details of conditions under which a licence for the standard as a further safeguard. use of the IS1 Certification Mark may bc granted to manufacturers or processors, may be obtained from the Indian Standards Institution.
